title: Faddeev-Skyrme solitons: lattice library and manuscript source
description:
Computational supplement to two companion papers on Faddeev-Skyrme and Skyrme soliton energies.

  • Lattice library with a symmetrised energy free of the Nyquist null mode, whose analytic variation is the exact gradient of the discrete energy
  • Two discretisation schemes, O(h^2) and O(h^4), with errors of opposite sign
  • Periodic and Dirichlet boundary conditions, for a paired comparison in which only the boundary differs
  • Joint lattice-spacing and finite-volume extrapolation
  • Two verification suites: one re-derives the physics from stored fields, the other checks the manuscripts against what the code produced
  • CPU and CUDA from a single code path, double precision throughout
